Name: HXW Mixology 101
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xOnA2oQ.png[/img]

[u][b][font=Georgia][size=5]Overview:[/size][/font][/b][/u][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Adds 50+ new recipes and crafting items focused on craft cocktails, mocktails and mixology[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Items include new bitters, fruit juices, alcohols, cocktails and mocktails[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Use the Distilling Station from Gourmet Pantry to make syrups and alcohols![/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=5][b][center]FOR 1.6 - Cocktails and Mocktails are now one mod here on H&W Mixology! Enable/disable cocktails and mocktails easily via the config file or GMCM! [/center][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][b]NOTE[/b] - these are meant to be fun and not necessarily based on any specific cocktail combos. Please don't come for us about how the drinks are not accurate to any real life counterpart please heehee <3 

[b][size=5]General Crafting Overview for the Distilling Station (alcohol enabled only)[/size][/b]
[size=4]Wine -->  Brandy
Wheat --> Gin
Potato --> Vodka
Sugar --> Rum
Cactus Fruit --> Tequila
Corn --> Whiskey
Joja Cola --> Club Soda
Quartz --> Mineral Water
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img]

And all my SDV discord friends - A lovely community I am truly so grateful to be a part of <3[/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DhwwHA2.png[/img]

[i][center]This mod is lovingly translated by several talented people into the following languages:

[b]English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, French, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Russian.[/b]

If you would like to translate this mod into another language, please reach out to me. If there is something missing from your translation version, please let me know! But also remember [u]translators are just volunteers[/u] and though I am eternally grateful for their work, they are not [u]required[/u] to do so and so there can be delays with updating translation files!

For Traditional Chinese, please see the blog post our friend Lala wrote [url=https://forum.gamer.com.tw/C.php?bsn=20774&snA=2187]HERE[/url] for help installing.[/center][/i][/size][/font][img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img]

[size=4][center]Fully compatible with all item mods since migration to 1.6

[b]Currently not working with Custom Crafting Stations - will add back in once I can get it working![/b]

Added compatibility with other mod authors is always welcome! Please reach out and I'd be happy to chat about how to work together.[/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img]
